design.chosen: (1) build.rs stages the binary assets into the embed folder
design.why: tauri-codegen 3.0.0-alpha.2 (context.rs/embedded_assets.rs) walks the frontendDist directory with WalkDir when tauri::generate_context!() expands, panics only when the directory itself is missing, and embeds every file found. That expansion happens in the lib compile, after the build script of the same package. build.rs therefore completes ui-dist/fonts from the canonical packages first. A clean clone needs no staging command; cargo check/build keep working because index.html/app.js/app.css/svg stay tracked (the directory exists) and a missing source only warns, except under --features custom-protocol (shipped config) where it fails loudly. Design (2) was rejected: the embed happens at macro expansion, so a missing font is a silent runtime loss, and tauri.ts is not on the cargo path. A symlink was rejected (Windows target, WalkDir follow_links would work but git symlinks do not).
design.notEmbeddedHere: crates/ai/app-server/build.rs embeds only index.html, app.js, app.css from ui-dist (include_str!), so it never needed the fonts.
design.writeSafety: write to <name>.partial-<pid> then rename; identical content is not rewritten, so mtimes stay stable

The existing build.rs line cargo:rerun-if-changed=../../packages/app-ui points to a path that does not exist from crates/ui/app (crates/packages/app-ui); I believe Cargo then reruns the script on every invocation (unverified). I kept it; the staging is idempotent and cheap (reads 21 MB, writes nothing when identical).
